brief: A workbench organizer: two storeys, bins on top, a drawer below, all edges capped.

requirements.evidence: Half-n bases at level 0 and level 1 in two columns (piece:0,0,0/0,0,1 and piece:1,0,0/1,0,1), snapped together and joined by side connectors on each storey
bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-half-n-full-div3 and bin:1,0,1~hex-bin-half-n-full-div2 on the top storey
drawer:0#0,0#cut and drawer:0#1,0#cut on the cut faces of the bottom-storey half bases

11 solid caps fitted. One edge on the bottom storey (1,0,0, bearing 150) can't take a cap: it runs into the drawer frame (MESH_CLASH), and with that drawer removed it runs into the side connector. check_build lists it as OPEN_CAP_FACE.
lockJoints ran but no joint bolts were offered, so it bolted nothing. The two columns are held together by single side connectors on each storey instead.

finish.summary: I built a two-storey workbench organizer from two columns of north-half bases. The top storey has a 3-compartment bin and a 2-compartment bin, and the bottom storey has a drawer under each column. A side connector joins the two columns on each storey. The final check passed with no rule errors and no part collisions. One edge on the bottom storey is still open: the configurator refused its cap because it runs into the left drawer's frame, and it would also hit the side connector. So "all edges capped" is only partly met. I didn't add any props.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
